tools.name: publish_to_social
tools.title: Publish to social
tools.description: Queue a finished post for publishing to the signed-in user's X or LinkedIn account. Can accept a base64 image and a scheduled time.

post_content.description: The finished post text, exactly as it should be published.

image_base64.description: Optional. The raw base64 string of the image file (without the data:image prefix).

image_mime_type.description: Optional. The mime type of the image, e.g. 'image/png' or 'image/jpeg'.

scheduled_for.description: Optional. The ISO 8601 timestamp for when this post should be published. Defaults to now if omitted.
